As you enter, a welcoming and tranquil ambiance envelops the entire apartment. This spacious 4-room residence is thoughtfully designed with an efficient layout, featuring large window sections that allow ample natural light to permeate the space, complemented by underfloor heating throughout. The hallway provides a practical area to hang coats and store shoes before stepping into the expansive open-plan kitchen and living area. The kitchen is fitted with an elegant white Svane design, offering a striking contrast to the warm oak parquet flooring. Equipped with modern appliances-including a stovetop, fridge/freezer, built-in oven, and dishwasher-this space seamlessly accommodates a dining area adjacent to the kitchen as well as a cozy living room where one can relax. From the kitchen-living area, a spacious balcony overlooks the courtyard, providing an inviting outdoor retreat to enjoy the sun with a cool beverage. The main bedroom is generously sized, allowing sufficient room for both bed and storage needs. Connected to this bedroom is the apartment's storage room, featuring built-in closets that provide additional space for belongings. Two further rooms differ in size, offering flexibility for use as an additional living arrangement, home office, or children's bedroom. The bathroom is fitted with large grey tiles and includes a separate shower enclosure, alongside a washer and dryer for added convenience. Please note that the photos may depict a different unit; consequently, interior design, orientation, and views might vary. However, all residences in the building share identical material choices and quality. Refer to the floor plan for this specific apartment's layout.

This attractive courtyard building offers excellent conditions for fostering a vibrant community, centered around the communal house, orangery, and courtyard itself. Designed by C.F. Møller Architects, the property comprises 264 apartments ranging from 2 to 5 rooms, catering to various household sizes and needs. Within the courtyard area, residents have access to several shared amenities, including the charming communal house paired with a cozy orangery designed to encourage wellbeing and support a flourishing social environment. Parking permits are available at a monthly fee of 400 DKK. Hørkær Have is on track for DGNB Gold certification, guaranteeing an environmentally conscious living space that promotes health and comfort. This certification reflects the use of eco-friendly materials, a well-considered indoor climate, and value-adding communal facilities.

Located centrally in Herlev, Hørkær Have is just a short distance from the heart of the town and approximately 13 kilometers from Copenhagen City Hall Square. With proximity to the S-train station, Motorway Ring 3, and the light rail expected to open in 2025, connectivity is seamless to numerous destinations. Living here means easy access to everything needed for a balanced lifestyle rich in quality and convenience. Whether you are drawn to vibrant shopping experiences or the tranquility of nature, both can be found nearby. A ten-minute walk leads to Herlev town center, which hosts shopping options, cultural events, and a weekly green market offering fresh produce. Herlev also presents a welcome respite from urban noise, with green spaces such as Sømosen and Nature Center Kildegården where families can enjoy serene natural surroundings and encounter animals including lambs and bull calves. The town boasts a lively sports culture, prioritizing excellent facilities that support a wide variety of activities suitable for the entire family-from team sports and ball games to martial arts, horseback riding, and swimming.
